deviations.description: Phase 1 verification expected 'Check A passed' immediately after the .gitignore append.
deviations.reason: check-runtime-file-tracking.sh probes Check A for two of the nine patterns (.orchestrator-multi-state.json, .events.lock) at their real specs/ root path rather than a synthetic specs/000_probe/ path, because no probe copy exists for those singleton files. Both real paths are still git-tracked at this point in the run, and git check-ignore reports a currently-tracked path as NOT ignored regardless of pattern match (verified independently in a throwaway repo). The other 7 of 9 patterns correctly report OK. This is a script-probe artifact, not a .gitignore defect: both paths are already on Phase 2's Check-B remediation list, so untracking them in Phase 2 resolves this Check A anomaly as a side effect.
